alec: Heads-up — nightly benchmark job (model-refresh + bench-suite) failed at 03:12 UTC. CI shows non-zero exit in refresh step, then subsequent benchmarks skipped. Anyone able to take a look? :eyes:

jamie: Can you paste the tail of the refresh log?

alec: Sure:
```
[2025-10-01T03:12:07Z] ERROR: model-refresh: Failed to pull artifacts: checksum mismatch
Traceback: RuntimeError("checksum mismatch for model v2.1.3")
Exit code: 1
```

sophia: Huh, checksum mismatch. We pushed a revision to the model registry yesterday — could be a partial upload. @jamie did you see any artifact health alerts?

jamie: I saw one alert but assumed it was transient. Checking registry: the s3 object size is smaller for v2.1.3 and ETag differs. Likely incomplete upload from the onboarding job.

alec: Great catch. Should we re-upload or point the nightly to v2.1.2 for now? The bench suite needs to run for the release report.

sophia: Quick triage: revert nightly config to v2.1.2 and re-run. I'll open a follow-up to reingest v2.1.3 later. @ci-bot can you re-run the nightly after config change?

ci-bot: @sophia Config updated: model_version -> v2.1.2. Triggering re-run of pipeline #bb-nightly-2025-10-01 :gear:

ci-bot: Re-run queued (job id: 5543). ETA ~10m.

jamie: If it fails again, let's bisect the last model-upload task. For now I can keep watch and escalate to infra if S3 shows partial writes.

alec: Thanks. One more note — cleanup cron (old-artifacts-cleaner) started failing later with permission denied on the registry bucket. Might be related; filing infra ticket.

sophia: Filing ticket as INFRA-987. Adding owners @infra-team. :+1:

alec: Cool. Will update the release doc once re-run completes. :rocket:
